speaker: Doctor
text: I see you're experiencing fatigue, flank pain, and fever following treatment for sinusitis. Can you describe the severity and location of your flank pain, and have you noticed any changes in your urine, such as blood or increased frequency?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have any tenderness when I press firmly on your back just below your ribs? Also, are you experiencing any burning or urgency when you urinate?

speaker: Patient
text: I was first treated with amoxicillin for sinusitis and developed a rash. Then the antibiotic was changed to cephalexin for another week, and the rash went away.

speaker: Doctor
text: Did the rash appear after starting amoxicillin and resolve when you switched to cephalexin? Have you experienced any swelling in your legs or face, or noticed frothy urine?

speaker: Patient
text: I do not have nausea, vomiting, or burning with urination. I also have not noticed a major change in urine color.

speaker: Doctor
text:
REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis
REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Urinalysis: Leukocyturia: Present, Bacterial_Culture: Negative, Cytospin_Stained_With_Hansel’s_Solution: 3% binucleated cells with eosinophilic, granular cytoplasm. Complete_Blood_Count: NORMAL READINGS

speaker: Doctor
text: The presence of eosinophils in the urine and a negative bacterial culture strongly suggests an allergic reaction to the medication rather than an infection. Given your recent history of a rash after taking amoxicillin, I suspect this is acute interstitial nephritis. DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Interstitial Nephritis
